C0540.title: What 225 'Abnormal' Return-and-Refund Successes Reveal
C0540.summary: A consumer in Shandong used multiple accounts to order high-value goods and then return swapped-in low-value items, completing 225 abnormal return-and-refund operations within half a year, causing direct merchant losses exceeding 50,000 yuan and triggering a police investigation.
